items.title: Flat base change for the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the flat base change theorem in the setting of algebraic spaces: the base change map on higher direct images is an isomorphism for a flat morphism of the base, with the affine form identifying the cohomology after a flat base change with the tensor product (statement lines 1921-1946). The proof produces the base change map from the flat case for morphisms of sites, reduces the question to an affine base, computes the pushforward along the affine base change explicitly, and evaluates the resulting cohomology by expressing the flat algebra as a filtered colimit of finite free modules and moving colimits through cohomology. The colimit computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
